description_sq:
Vile 4-kateshe prane Venue Club per shitje!
Ne zonen e Kodres se Priftit, prane Venue Club, ofrojme vile 4-kateshe per shitje!
Me siperfaqe totale ndertimi prej 608.6 m2 dhe siperfaqe trualli pre 504.39 m2, vila eshte e organizuar:
- Kati perdhe: siperfaqe 101.5 m2, koridor shperndares, 1 sallon, 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet
- Kati pare: siperfaqe 167.9 m2 ndertim dhe 20.9 m2 verande, koridor shperndares, 1 sallon, 4 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet dhe veranda
- Kati dyte: siperfaqe 136.2 m2 ndertim dhe 80.5 m2 verande, koridor shperndares, 1 sallon, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe veranda
- Kati trete: siperfaqe 101.6 m2, koridor shperndares, 1 sallon, 1 dhome gjumi, 1 tualet dhe 1 ballkon
Vila eshte e rrethuar nga nje oborr me siperfaqe prej 336 m2 dhe ofron mundesi parkimi automjetesh. Vila dispononon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekeor, ku cdo kat eshte i certifikuar si apartament i vecante. Vendodhja ofron akses te shpejt ne rrethrotullimin e Shkozes dhe Unazan e Re. 
Ideale per banim ose per investim!
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni!
description_en: 4-storey villa near Venue Club for sale! In the Kodre se Prifti area, near the Venue Club, we offer 4-storey villas for sale! With a total construction area of 608.6 m2 and a land area of 504.39 m2, the villa is organized: - Ground floor: 101.5 m2 area, distribution corridor, 1 living room, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom - First floor: 167.9 m2 construction area and 20.9 m2 veranda, distribution corridor, 1 living room, 4 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and veranda - Second floor: 136.2 m2 construction area and 80.5 m2 veranda, distribution corridor, 1 living room, 3 bedrooms, 2 toilets and veranda - Third floor: 101.6 m2 area, distribution corridor, 1 living room, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and 1 balcony The villa is surrounded by a courtyard with of 336 m2 and offers the possibility of parking vehicles. The villa has regular mortgage documentation, where each floor is certified as a separate apartment. The location offers quick access to the Shkoza roundabout and Unazan e Re. Ideal for residence or investment! For more information contact us!
